title: Identification of subtypes and biomarkers associated with disulfidptosis-related ferroptosis in ulcerative colitis.
authors: Jiang, Yinghao; Meng, Hongyan; Zhang, Xin; Yang, Jinguang; Sun, Chengxin; Wang, Xiaoyan
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于溃疡性结肠炎转录组数据识别亚型和生物标志物，涉及免疫浸润和转录因子关联分析，但核心是疾病分型与标志物筛选，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Disulfidptosis and ferroptosis are different programmed cell death modes, which are closely related to the development of a variety of diseases, but the relationship between them and ulcerative colitis (UC) is still unclear. Therefore, our study aimed to explore the molecular subtypes and biomarkers associated with disulfidptosis-related ferroptosis (DRF) in UC. METHODS: We used Pearson analysis to identify DRF genes. Then, we classified 140 UC samples into different subtypes based on the DRF genes and explored the biological and clinical characteristics between them. Next, the hub genes were identified by differential analysis and WGCNA algorithms, and three machine learning algorithms were used to screen biomarkers for UC from hub genes. In addition, we analyzed the relationship between biomarkers of immune cells and transcription factors and predicted natural compounds that might be used to treat UC. Finally, we further verified the reliability of the markers by RT-qPCR experiments. RESULTS: 118 DRF genes were identified using Pearson analysis. Based on the expression level of the DRF genes, we classified UC patients into C1 and C2 subtypes, with significant differences in the abundance of immune infiltration and disease activity between the two subtypes. The machine learning algorithms identified three biomarkers, including XBP1, FH, and MAP3K5. Further analyses revealed that the three biomarkers were closely associated with a variety of immune cells and transcription factors. In addition, six natural compounds corresponding to the biomarkers were predicted, which may contribute to the effective treatment of UC. Finally, the expression trends of XBP1, FH, and MAP3K5 in animal experiments were consistent with the results of bioinformatics analysis. CONCLUSION: In this study, we systematically elucidated the role of DRF genes in the development of UC, and identified three potential biomarkers, providing a new idea for the diagnosis and treatment of UC.
abstract_zh: 背景：二硫化物凋亡（disulfidptosis）与铁死亡（ferroptosis）是不同形式的程序性细胞死亡模式，与多种疾病的发生发展密切相关，但二者与溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）之间的关系尚不明确。因此，本研究旨在探索与二硫化物凋亡相关铁死亡（disulfidptosis-related ferroptosis, DRF）相关的UC分子亚型和生物标志物。方法：我们使用Pearson分析来识别DRF基因。随后，基于DRF基因将140个UC样本分为不同亚型，并探讨其间的生物学和临床特征。接下来，通过差异分析和WGCNA算法鉴定核心基因，并利用三种机器学习算法从核心基因中筛选UC的生物标志物。此外，我们分析了生物标志物与免疫细胞和转录因子之间的关系，并预测了可能用于治疗UC的天然化合物。最后，通过RT-qPCR实验进一步验证了标志物的可靠性。结果：通过Pearson分析识别出118个DRF基因。基于DRF基因的表达水平，我们将UC患者分为C1和C2亚型，两种亚型在免疫浸润丰度和疾病活动性方面存在显著差异。机器学习算法鉴定出三种生物标志物，包括XBP1、FH和MAP3K5。进一步分析显示，这三种生物标志物与多种免疫细胞和转录因子密切相关。此外，预测了与生物标志物对应的六种天然化合物，可能有助于UC的有效治疗。最后，动物实验中XBP1、FH和MAP3K5的表达趋势与生物信息学分析结果一致。结论：在本研究中，我们系统阐明了DRF基因在UC发展中的作用，并鉴定出三种潜在生物标志物，为UC的诊断和治疗提供了新思路。
